summary.name: PicDoc
summary.one_liner: PicDoc is an AI text-to-visual tool that turns text, research content, or uploaded documents into infographics, scientific mechanism diagrams, flowcharts, and charts, and also offers text parsing, writing assistance, and knowledge-base archiving.
use_cases: Drawing mechanism and signaling pathway diagrams for SCI papers
Creating experimental flowcharts and technical route diagrams
Building research framework or thesis structure diagrams
Making data charts such as bar, line, heatmap and scatter plots
Producing academic PPTs and proposal slides
Summarizing uploaded papers and archiving notes into a knowledge base
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AI that reads pasted text or uploaded Word/PDF files, extracts core points, methods, innovations and conclusions with source tracing, and supports AI-assisted writing such as abstracts, outlines and translation. Users can generate scientific diagrams (mechanism, signaling pathway, experimental flow, technical route), data charts, infographics and PPTs from text or experimental data. Generated graphics can be edited online, with image and text separated, and exported as PDF, PNG, PPT or 4K high-resolution images, including vector output. It also links and archives files to build a knowledge base for Q&A and notes.
notable: Generates scientific mechanism, signaling pathway and experimental flow diagrams from text or uploaded papers
Exports high-resolution vector graphics and 4K images, stated as watermark-free in the description
Builds a knowledge base from uploaded files and links with source tracing
caveats: Page says 免费试用 (free trial) with no download needed; full pricing and limits are not stated on the page
Chart and figure styling is adjusted by the user after generation; the page does not claim fully automatic publication-ready output
